name: Wild Leather Shoulders

aliases: who needs thick armor kits camp mojache
faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider seeks the materials in Camp Mojache.
faq.q: Who wants the Wild Leather Shoulders supplies?

faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider stays in Camp Mojache.
He needs six thick armor kits and one wildvine.
faq.q: What items does Jangdor Swiftstrider need?

sections.body: Jangdor Swiftstrider makes his camp among the Horde in Camp Mojache. To craft Wild Leather Shoulders, he requires six thick armor kits and a single wildvine brought directly to him.
sections.title: Supplies for Jangdor

summary: In Camp Mojache, Jangdor Swiftstrider seeks supplies to craft Wild Leather Shoulders. He needs six thick armor kits and a wildvine brought to his workshop.
